item.title: Climate talks in Nairobi agree new adaptation fund
item.description: Countries at the UN climate summit in Nairobi have agreed to set up a fund of at least $40bn a year from 2028 to help nations adapt to climate change.

item.title: EU foreign ministers back new sanctions package against shipping network
item.description: European Union foreign ministers have approved a new package of sanctions targeting a network of shipping companies accused of evading earlier restrictions. The measures include asset freezes on 23 companies and travel bans for nine individuals.
